records.subject: Re: Cancellation timing
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Here's what I found. A cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately, so you won't lose the days you've already paid for.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for setting up Maple Media on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero engagement: no reply to onboarding email [email:3863dae5], no project, no invite, no tickets. No signal of intent or active evaluation, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely though not impossible for a self-serve Starter account.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Following up on my note from last week. Since things have been quiet, I wanted to make it easy to get Maple Media's first project set up -- projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that first one usually unlocks everything else. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Chidi
